newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures end firmer on short-covering.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures end firmer on short-covering.

text.p: Japanese rubber futures ended firmer across the board on Monday, as cautionary views that prices were too low after falls last week stimulated some short-covering, traders said.
Prices ranged from flat to 0.9 yen per kg higher. Benchmark September was up 0.8 yen at 150.3 yen.
The market started the day on a firmer note, as relatively cheap prices compared with overseas markets attracted sporadic short-covering. But bearish sentiment remained intact.
"The upside may be limited as selling could emerge when the benchmark approaches 152 or 153 yen," one trader said.
